measurements.scope: A 1989 paper hypothesizes a 5,000 km buoyancy-driven coastal connection from southern Greenland to the Middle Atlantic Bight based on limited oxygen-isotope evidence. This proposed system length is unranked and is not the length of the Labrador Current alone.
